content.stem: 金融机构（FI）应为拟开立新银行账户的新企业客户审查哪些风险因素？（选择三项。）

options.A: 新客户目前开户或曾经开户的所有金融机构
options.B: 该企业客户所从事的业务类型
options.C: 新客户所有员工的就业情况和信息
options.D: 客户所属的国家或地区,或客户开展业务的国家或地区
options.E: 高级管理人员的身份以及所有获授权操作该账户的个人身份

content.stem_en: Which risk factors should a financial institution (FI) examine for a new corporate customer intending to open a new bank account? (Select three.)

options_en.A: All the financial institutions where the new customer currently banks or banked previously.
options_en.B: The type of business the corporate customer is engaged in.
options_en.C: The employment profiles and information of all employees of the new customer.
options_en.D: The country or location where the customer is from or conducts business.
options_en.E: The identity of senior managing officials and all individuals authorized to operate the account.
